newsitem.title: USA: NeXstar says FDA set AmBisome review date.
newsitem.headline: NeXstar says FDA set AmBisome review date.

text.p: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has scheduled a July 16 meeting to review the new drug application for AmBisome, a potential treatment for a condition known as fever of unknown origin (FUO), NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday.

NeXstar, which developed AmBisome, and Fujisawa USA Inc, a marketing partner in the drug's trials, said in a statement that FDA's Antiviral Drug Advisory Committee would review data from a Phase III study.
The study compared AmBisome to amphotericin B in the treatment of FUO, the companies said.
FUO is a condition in patients with a low white blood cell count who have fungal infections after unresponsive antibiotic therapy for a high fever.

Patients at risk for FUO are those with compromised immune systems, such as patients receiving bone marrow or solid organ transplants, AIDS patients and patients undergoing chemotherapy, the companies said.
NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc is an integrated pharmaceutical company engaged in the development and manufacture of products to treat life-threatening diseases.
Fujisawa USA Inc, headquartered in Deerfield, Ill., is a manufacturer of proprietary and multi-source pharmaceutical products and a subsidiary of Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co.
